title: Check soil and rotation readiness
description: Collect samples across South Pasture, including the weaker growth zones. Review pH, available nutrients, and root-zone moisture before confirming the next operations.
rationale: Current pH 6.6, nitrogen 45 mg/kg, and moisture 67%.

title: Review crop growth and stressed zones
description: Walk the field and compare canopy development in the marked health zones. Record pest pressure and changes in the corn crop.
rationale: Follow up on the current crop health score of 94/100.

title: Harvest corn
description: Inspect maturity and grain moisture, then arrange harvest across 28.1 hectares. Retain residues where practical and log the harvested yield.
rationale: Expected maturity window for the current crop and growing season.

title: Establish post-harvest cover
description: Inspect harvest residues and establish a suitable winter cover where conditions allow. Protect the soil between harvest and the next main crop.
rationale: A cover period is included in the gap before the next spring planting.

title: Prepare the seedbed for soybeans
description: Review the latest soil results, manage residues, and prepare equipment for the transition to soybeans. Confirm seed availability and the field's trafficability.
rationale: Scheduled after the current harvest, aiming for 14 days before the calculated planting date.

title: Plant soybeans for the 2027 season
description: Rotate South Pasture from corn to soybeans. Check soil readiness and establish the crop within the calculated ten-day planting window.
rationale: 92% model confidence. Starts with the regional soybeans planting window.

title: Plant corn for the 2028 season
description: Continue the proposed rotation from soybeans to corn. Review this longer-term step after the 2027 harvest and new soil results.
rationale: Second step in the predicted crop sequence; reviewed as new field observations become available.

title: Review irrigation and root-zone moisture
description: Check water distribution and inspect the driest parts of East Ridge. Adjust the watering plan around the expected rain and record moisture after the next pass.
rationale: Current soil moisture is 32%, below the field’s comfortable range.

title: Review and apply the nutrient top-up
description: Use the soil check results to confirm the nutrient plan. Arrange the planned application around the light rain window and record the applied rate.
rationale: Available nitrogen is 12 mg/kg. Address the shortage before the next crop review.
